title: Asking
label: ch:zh-asking
canDo: I can understand, say, read and write 吗, 你好吗, 是吗 and 好不好, turn any statement I already own into a yes-or-no question by either of Mandarin's two patterns, and score listening, speaking, reading and writing separately.

payoff.summary: Before this chapter the track could greet, name, count to five and say what it read, and could not ask a yes-or-no question about any of it. One character closes that and does more than its own weight: 吗 goes on the end of a finished sentence and changes nothing else, so every statement already taught becomes a question. The second pattern costs no character at all -- it is 不, held since the negation lesson, placed between two copies of a word.
